summary: TSMC filed a routine monthly Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) covering August 2026. It discloses minor insider share changes (VP B.Z. Tien +1,000 and VP Lipen Yuan +2,350 shares), no pledge changes, no asset acquisitions or dispositions, no unsecured bond issuance, and no common-share cancellation. The board approved capital appropriations of US$16,035 million for advanced-technology machinery, US$4,791 million for advanced packaging and mature/specialty capacity, and US$8,616 million for real estate and capitalized leased assets. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, or recommendation is stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
